about_the_game:
WETTOP is a thrilling parkour adventure where every step matters.
Climb, jump, and sprint your way through a vertical world filled with floating platforms, dangerous gaps, and unpredictable obstacles.

You start with 10 shared lives — make them count.
One mistake can cost you, and once the lives are gone… it’s game over.

Simple controls, but challenging paths.
Every level demands precision timing, smart movement, and quick thinking.

 Face mini tasks and puzzles along the way to unlock checkpoints or gain an edge.
From pressure pads to leap-of-faith jumps, each challenge keeps you on your toes.

Set in a foggy mountain landscape, WETTOP brings a mysterious, dream-like vibe.
Watch clouds move around you as you climb toward the unknown.

Inspired by Only Up but with its own heartbeat-style life system,
WETTOP blends tension, beauty, and parkour mechanics into a unique experience.

Designed as a solo experience — no distractions, just you vs the climb.
Every fall feels personal, every success feels earned.

 The glowing 10-life heartbeat health bar keeps you visually connected to survival.
Feel your lives pulse with intensity as you progress higher.

How far can you go without falling?
Will you conquer WETTOP or run out of time?

🧗 The climb starts now.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 560 ( 2 GB VRAM )
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580 ( 4 GB VRAM )
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: WETTOP is a challenging first-person parkour adventure where every jump counts. With only 10 lives, your goal is to climb to the top of a towering world filled with thrilling jumps, moving platforms, and surprising tasks. Miss a jump, and you fall—lose a life. Lose them all? It's game over.
